title: A shape can vanish while its source survives
question: Which geometric properties and source records survive bending, cutting and collapsing a shape?
method: Explicit circle transformations, finite-code tests and a separately retained source ledger, with distinct similarity, topology and injectivity criteria.
finding: The model separates geometric information loss from retained source provenance; a source record does not repair a noninjective observation.
claim_scope: Defined mathematical transformations and26 recorded bounded software checks; not physical identity, consciousness or a universal recognition algorithm.
limitations: Similarity, topology, labeled fragments and provenance are distinct criteria, not one strict total ordering.
A ledger preserving the source does not make a collapsed coordinate map one-to-one.
The software tests are finite checks; geometrical arguments depend on their stated transformations and domain.
No consciousness, common physical origin or organism learning follows. No new UI or scientific run was performed for publication.
open_questions: How much source information must a representation retain to distinguish originals after a lossy transformation?
